title: 第十三章 炼丹堂验毒废丹又成线索第十四章 毒茶反制决赛前天赋刷新
slug: 天赋每周一刷新从变废为宝开始成仙
content_zh:
入前八后，小比暂停半日。
一来让弟子恢复灵力，二来执事们要审查魏世成服用禁丹一事。
周荒趁机去盘口领灵石。
一千五百块下品灵石装入储物袋时，他差点没忍住笑出声。
穷了这么久，终于富了一把。
可他很快压下兴奋。
灵石再多，也得能活着花。
魏世成的血灵丹，显然不是他自己能弄来的。
刚走出坊市，沈青禾的纸鹤便飞了过来。
炼丹堂。
外门丹房比废丹房干净太多。
一座座丹炉整齐排布，空气里弥漫着草木药香。
沈青禾站在一口青铜丹炉前，桌上摆着那两枚血灵丹。
“过来。”
周荒走近。
沈青禾指着丹药。
“你看出什么？”
周荒本想说自己不懂丹道，可百倍悟性仍在，他只是盯着丹药看了片刻，脑海中便浮现诸多念头。
丹皮暗红，药气外溢。
主材像赤血草，辅材有狂灵花、焚脉砂，还有一味阴属性药渣掩盖气味。

“药力不纯，爆发太急。”
周荒缓缓道。
“其中有焚脉砂，会让经脉短暂扩张，事后萎缩。若连续服用，轻则修为倒退，重则灵根受损。”
沈青禾眼神一亮。
“你以前学过丹道？”
“没有。”
“那你怎么看出来的？”
周荒认真道：
“可能是在废丹房待久了，对坏丹比较熟。”
沈青禾沉默了一下。
理由离谱。
但又有几分合理。
她丢给周荒一枚空白玉简。
“基础药性篇，一炷香内看完。”
周荒灵识探入。
百倍悟性轰然运转，一味味灵草的药性、相克、火候、成丹变化，像水流般涌入脑海。
一炷香后，他睁开眼。
“看完了。”
沈青禾随口问了几味药性，周荒一一答出。
旁边两个丹房弟子看他的眼神渐渐变了。

沈青禾没有立刻让他独立炼丹，而是开启丹炉，丢入几味普通药材。
“我控主炉，你控火。炼一炉驱浊丹。”
周荒站到丹炉前，掌心青红灵焰涌出。
百倍悟性下，他能清楚感到药材在炉中每一分变化。
content_en:
After entering the top eight, Xiaobi paused for half a day.
First, let the disciples recover their spiritual power, and second, the deacons want to examine Wei Shicheng's taking of forbidden pills.
Zhou Huang took the opportunity to go to Pankou to receive the spirit stone.
When fifteen hundred low-grade spiritual stones were put into the storage bag, he almost couldn't help but laugh.
After being poor for so long, I finally became rich.
But he quickly suppressed his excitement.
No matter how many spiritual stones you have, you still have to be able to spend them alive.
Wei Shicheng's Blood Spirit Pill was obviously not something he could obtain by himself.
As soon as he walked out of Fangshi, Shen Qinghe's paper crane flew over.
Alchemy Hall.
The outer alchemy room is much cleaner than the useless alchemy room.
Alchemy furnaces are neatly arranged, and the air is filled with the fragrance of herbs and medicinal herbs.
Shen Qinghe stood in front of a bronze pill furnace, with the two Blood Spirit Pills placed on the table.
"Come here."
Zhou Huang approached.
Shen Qinghe pointed at the elixir.
"What do you see?"
Zhou Huang wanted to say that he didn't understand the way of alchemy, but his understanding was still there. He just stared at the elixir for a moment, and many thoughts came to his mind.
The bark of the pill is dark red, and the medicinal energy overflows.
The main material is red blood grass, the auxiliary materials include Kuang Linghua, Burning Vein Sand, and a Yin-type medicinal residue to cover up the smell.
"The medicine is not pure, and it explodes too quickly."
Zhou Huang said slowly.
"There is Burning Vein Sand in it, which will cause the meridians to expand temporarily and then shrink later. If you take it continuously, your cultivation will regress at best, and your spiritual roots will be damaged at worst."
Shen Qinghe's eyes lit up.
"Have you ever learned alchemy before?"
"No."
"Then how did you tell?"
Zhou Huang said seriously:
"Maybe it's because I've been in the waste elixir room for a long time and I'm familiar with bad elixirs."
Shen Qinghe was silent for a moment.
The reason is outrageous.
But it's somewhat reasonable.
She threw a blank jade slip to Zhou Huang.
"Basic medicinal properties, you can read it in one stick of incense."
Zhou Huang's spiritual consciousness penetrated.
A hundredfold understanding surged forward, and the medicinal properties, mutual restraints, heat conditions, and elixir-forming changes of the spiritual herbs poured into my mind like water.
After burning the incense, he opened his eyes.
"It's over."
Shen Qinghe casually asked about the properties of several medicinal herbs, and Zhou Huang answered them one by one.
The eyes of the two alchemy disciples next to him gradually changed when they looked at him.
Shen Qinghe did not immediately let him make alchemy independently, but opened the alchemy furnace and threw in a few ordinary medicinal materials.
"I control the main furnace and you control the fire. Make a furnace of turbid elixirs."
Zhou Huang stood in front of the alchemy furnace, green and red spiritual flames gushing out from his palms.
With a hundredfold understanding, he could clearly feel every change of the medicinal materials in the furnace.
